EnableUndeadCriticalHits.Name: Critical Hits by Undead
EnableUndeadCriticalHits.Hint: Enables special consequences when an undead creature critically hits with an attack. Requires a world reload.

EnableUndeadCriticalFumbles.Name: Critical Fumbles by Undead
EnableUndeadCriticalFumbles.Hint: Enables special consequences when an undead creature critically fumbles an attack. Requires a world reload.

EnableCriticalHitsAgainstUndead.Name: Critical Hits against Undead
EnableCriticalHitsAgainstUndead.Hint: Enables special consequences when an undead creature suffers a critical hit. Requires a world reload.

UndeadCriticalHits.Title: Undead Horrors: Critical Hits by Undead
UndeadCriticalHits.Description: Special consequences for critical hits made by undead attackers.

UndeadCriticalFumbles.Title: Undead Horrors: Critical Fumbles by Undead
UndeadCriticalFumbles.Description: Special consequences for critical fumbles made by undead attackers.

CriticalHitsAgainstUndead.Title: Undead Horrors: Critical Hits against Undead
CriticalHitsAgainstUndead.Description: Special consequences for critical hits against undead targets.

GraveChill.Title: Grave Chill
GraveChill.Description: Grave-cold power seeps into the victim. The target takes a 10-foot status penalty to all Speeds until the end of its next turn.

WitheringBlow.Title: Withering Blow
WitheringBlow.Description: The strike drains strength from living motion. The target is enfeebled 1 until the end of its next turn.

NumbingTouch.Title: Numbing Touch
NumbingTouch.Description: Deathly numbness crawls through muscle and nerve. The target is clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

SoulShaken.Title: Soul-Shaken
SoulShaken.Description: The blow brushes something deeper than flesh. The target is stupefied 1 until the end of its next turn.

FaceOfDeath.Title: Face of Death
FaceOfDeath.Description: For one terrible heartbeat, the victim sees death staring back. The target becomes frightened 1.

DeathlyOpening.Title: Deathly Opening
DeathlyOpening.Description: The unnatural impact tears open the target's guard. The target is off-guard until the end of its next turn.

FrozenReflexes.Title: Frozen Reflexes
FrozenReflexes.Description: The target's reactions turn sluggish and cold. It takes a -1 status penalty to Reflex saves until the end of its next turn.

StrengthOfTheGrave.Title: Strength of the Grave
StrengthOfTheGrave.Description: The critical hit feeds the force animating the dead. The undead attacker gains 4 temporary Hit Points for 1 round.

UnnaturalMomentum.Title: Unnatural Momentum
UnnaturalMomentum.Description: The dead attacker flows straight into its next assault. It gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls for 1 round.

GraspOfTheDead.Title: Grasp of the Dead
GraspOfTheDead.Description: The victim's instincts freeze under the touch of death. Until the beginning of its next turn, the target can't use reactions.

NecroticWound.Title: Necrotic Wound
NecroticWound.Description: The wound darkens at once as void energy gnaws at living tissue. The target takes 1d4 persistent void damage.

WitheredConstitution.Title: Withered Constitution
WitheredConstitution.Description: The target's vitality gutters. It takes a -1 status penalty to Fortitude saves until the end of its next turn.

DeathsPall.Title: Death's Pall
DeathsPall.Description: The target's guard falters specifically against the undead attacker. Until the undead finishes its next turn, the target takes a -1 status penalty to AC against that attacker.

TheGraveHungers.Title: The Grave Hungers
TheGraveHungers.Description: A fragment of stolen vitality clings to the attacker. Against a living target, the undead gains 3 temporary Hit Points for 1 round.

DeathsWeight.Title: Death's Weight
DeathsWeight.Description: The blow leaves the victim unable to make the careful footwork of a Step until the end of its next turn.

DeadeningBlow.Title: Deadening Blow
DeadeningBlow.Description: The world seems muffled and distant. The target takes a -1 status penalty to Perception until the end of its next turn.

RottingPain.Title: Rotting Pain
RottingPain.Description: The injury makes every forceful or precise motion revolt. The target takes a -1 status penalty to Strength- and Dexterity-based checks until the end of its next turn.

GravesEmbrace.Title: Grave's Embrace
GravesEmbrace.Description: The target moves as if the grave itself were holding on. It takes a -1 status penalty to Athletics and Acrobatics until the end of its next turn.

UnholyPersistence.Title: Unholy Persistence
UnholyPersistence.Description: The successful violence reinforces the undead's unnatural persistence. It gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws for 1 round.

DeathDoesNotTire.Title: Death Does Not Tire
DeathDoesNotTire.Description: Until the beginning of its next turn, the undead ignores the first -1 status penalty that would apply to one of its attack rolls.

WhispersBeyondTheVeil.Title: Whispers Beyond the Veil
WhispersBeyondTheVeil.Description: Voices from somewhere beyond death crowd the victim's thoughts. The target takes a -1 status penalty to Will saves until the end of its next turn.

MomentOfMortality.Title: Moment of Mortality
MomentOfMortality.Description: The living body recoils from intimate contact with death. The target becomes sickened 1.

PredatorOfTheLiving.Title: Predator of the Living
PredatorOfTheLiving.Description: The intelligent undead learns the victim's rhythm. It gains a +1 circumstance bonus to its next attack against that same target before the end of its next turn.

CruelSatisfaction.Title: Cruel Satisfaction
CruelSatisfaction.Description: The intelligent undead savors the opening. Until the end of its next turn, it gains a +1 status bonus to damage against the creature it critically hit.

MindlessOnslaught.Title: Mindless Onslaught
MindlessOnslaught.Description: The mindless dead lunges on without concern for defense. For 1 round it gains a +1 circumstance bonus to melee attack rolls and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC.

UnthinkingAdvance.Title: Unthinking Advance
UnthinkingAdvance.Description: Driven only by the next impact, the mindless undead immediately moves 5 feet toward the target if it can do so safely and without triggering a reaction.

SpectralShock.Title: Spectral Shock
SpectralShock.Description: The incorporeal attacker distorts the victim's senses as it passes through the edge of reality. The target is dazzled until the end of its next turn.

ThroughFleshAndSoul.Title: Through Flesh and Soul
ThroughFleshAndSoul.Description: The apparition cuts through body and spirit at once. The target takes a -1 status penalty to Will saves until the end of its next turn and can't use reactions until the beginning of that turn.

UnmooredSpirit.Title: Unmoored Spirit
UnmooredSpirit.Description: Body and spirit slip briefly out of alignment. Until the beginning of its next turn, the target is off-guard and takes a -1 status penalty to Reflex saves.

ColdHandOfTheBeyond.Title: Cold Hand of the Beyond
ColdHandOfTheBeyond.Description: Death clings to the wound. Until the end of its next turn, the living target can't benefit from fast healing or regeneration.

LooseBones.Title: Loose Bones
LooseBones.Description: Something in the undead frame slips out of place. The undead is clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

RottenJoint.Title: Rotten Joint
RottenJoint.Description: A decayed joint buckles under the failed motion. The undead takes a 10-foot status penalty to all Speeds until the end of its next turn.

OverextendedCorpse.Title: Overextended Corpse
OverextendedCorpse.Description: The dead body follows its own failed momentum too far. The undead is off-guard until the beginning of its next turn.

CrackedFrame.Title: Cracked Frame
CrackedFrame.Description: The fumble leaves the corporeal shell badly aligned. The undead takes a -1 status penalty to AC until the beginning of its next turn.

DeadWeight.Title: Dead Weight
DeadWeight.Description: Its own lifeless mass works against the undead. It takes a -1 status penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

UnsteadyRemains.Title: Unsteady Remains
UnsteadyRemains.Description: The remains wobble and fail to answer cleanly. The undead takes a -1 status penalty to Reflex saves until the end of its next turn.

AnimatingForceFalters.Title: Animating Force Falters
AnimatingForceFalters.Description: The force driving the dead body stutters. The undead is enfeebled 1 until the end of its next turn.

NecromanticMisfire.Title: Necromantic Misfire
NecromanticMisfire.Description: Necromantic energy recoils through the undead's pattern. The undead is stupefied 1 until the end of its next turn.

GraveEnergyLeak.Title: Grave Energy Leak
GraveEnergyLeak.Description: The fumble tears open the power holding the corpse or spirit together. The undead gains weakness 2 to vitality damage until the beginning of its next turn.

ExposedAnimation.Title: Exposed Animation
ExposedAnimation.Description: The undead's animating force is briefly exposed. The next damaging hit against it before the beginning of its next turn deals 2 additional vitality damage.

WrongWayAround.Title: Wrong Way Around
WrongWayAround.Description: A limb, weapon, or entire posture ends up pointed the wrong way. Until the beginning of its next turn, the corporeal undead can't use reactions.

CollapsedPosture.Title: Collapsed Posture
CollapsedPosture.Description: The undead's posture folds in on itself. It takes a -1 status penalty to Athletics and Acrobatics until the end of its next turn.

DraggingLimb.Title: Dragging Limb
DraggingLimb.Description: A leg or comparable support drags uselessly for a moment. The corporeal undead can't Step until the end of its next turn.

PartsEverywhere.Title: Parts Everywhere
PartsEverywhere.Description: Loose pieces, straps, fingers, or fragments scatter at the worst possible moment. Until the end of its next turn, the corporeal undead takes a -1 circumstance penalty to checks made as part of manipulate actions.

GraveDust.Title: Grave Dust
GraveDust.Description: Dust, rot, ectoplasm, or grave debris clouds the undead's awareness. It takes a -1 status penalty to Perception until the end of its next turn.

TwistedAnatomy.Title: Twisted Anatomy
TwistedAnatomy.Description: The failed attack leaves the body in an impossible fighting posture. The corporeal undead takes a -1 status penalty to melee attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

BodyRemembersDeath.Title: The Body Remembers Death
BodyRemembersDeath.Description: For a moment the corpse becomes what it truly is: dead weight. The corporeal undead takes a -1 status penalty to Fortitude saves until the end of its next turn.

UnlivingImbalance.Title: Unliving Imbalance
UnlivingImbalance.Description: The failed motion leaves the corporeal undead easy to shove, trip, or otherwise physically unbalance. It takes a -1 circumstance penalty to relevant defenses and checks until the end of its next turn.

HungerWithoutControl.Title: Hunger Without Control
HungerWithoutControl.Description: Frustration strips away the intelligent undead's discipline. It is off-guard against the creature it fumbled against until the beginning of its next turn.

PredatorsFrustration.Title: Predator's Frustration
PredatorsFrustration.Description: The intelligent undead fixates on its failure. It takes a -1 circumstance penalty to attacks against the creature it fumbled against until the end of its next turn.

MomentOfRecognition.Title: Moment of Recognition
MomentOfRecognition.Description: For one impossible instant, the intelligent undead remembers being something else. It is stupefied 1 until the end of its next turn.

RageAgainstTheLiving.Title: Rage Against the Living
RageAgainstTheLiving.Description: Failure turns discipline into murderous fury. Until the beginning of its next turn, the intelligent undead takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC; until the end of that turn, it deals 1 additional damage to the creature it fumbled against.

MindlessConfusion.Title: Mindless Confusion
MindlessConfusion.Description: The mindless animation loses its simple rhythm. Until the beginning of its next turn, the undead takes a -1 circumstance penalty to AC and can't use reactions.

UnthinkingLurch.Title: Unthinking Lurch
UnthinkingLurch.Description: The broken command sends the mindless dead stumbling 5 feet in a random safe direction, if such movement is possible without entering an obvious hazard.

BrokenCommand.Title: Broken Command
BrokenCommand.Description: The simple directive animating the corpse skips a beat. The mindless undead takes a -1 status penalty to Perception until the end of its next turn and a -1 circumstance penalty to its next attack before then.

UnstableManifestation.Title: Unstable Manifestation
UnstableManifestation.Description: The incorporeal form ripples and loses its shape. The undead is clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

FadingPresence.Title: Fading Presence
FadingPresence.Description: The apparition's presence flickers at the edge of reality. It takes a -1 status penalty to AC until the beginning of its next turn.

OutOfPhase.Title: Out of Phase
OutOfPhase.Description: The spirit slips a fraction too far from the world. Until the beginning of its next turn, the incorporeal undead can't use reactions.

SpiritualFeedback.Title: Spiritual Feedback
SpiritualFeedback.Description: The failed attack reverberates through the apparition's own essence. It takes a -1 status penalty to Will saves until the end of its next turn.

DeathComesApart.Title: Death Comes Apart
DeathComesApart.Description: For a grotesque instant the dead body simply stops being a coherent body and collapses. The corporeal undead is prone; the exact collapse is narrative and leaves no permanent injury.

BrokenAnimation.Title: Broken Animation
BrokenAnimation.Description: The critical hit disrupts the force animating the dead. The undead is enfeebled 1 until the end of its next turn.

DeathlyInstability.Title: Deathly Instability
DeathlyInstability.Description: The undead's unnatural balance wavers. It takes a -1 status penalty to Reflex saves until the end of its next turn.

GraveEnergyBleedsAway.Title: Grave Energy Bleeds Away
GraveEnergyBleedsAway.Description: Power leaks from the wound in cold wisps. The undead takes a -1 status penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

DisruptedPattern.Title: Disrupted Pattern
DisruptedPattern.Description: The blow leaves the undead's animating pattern briefly vulnerable. It takes a -1 penalty to its next saving throw before the end of its next turn.

ExposedNecromancy.Title: Exposed Necromancy
ExposedNecromancy.Description: The piercing critical tears into the power holding the undead together. It gains weakness 2 to vitality damage until the beginning of its next turn.

DeathlyOpening.Title: Deathly Opening
DeathlyOpening.Description: The critical hit opens a gap in the undead's defense. It is off-guard until the beginning of its next turn.

SeveredResponse.Title: Severed Response
SeveredResponse.Description: The impact interrupts the undead's ability to answer threats. Until the beginning of its next turn, it can't use reactions.

GraveStaggered.Title: Grave-Staggered
GraveStaggered.Description: The undead reels under a blow that would have dropped a living foe. It takes a 10-foot status penalty to all Speeds until the end of its next turn.

UnholyPatternFractured.Title: Unholy Pattern Fractured
UnholyPatternFractured.Description: The force that anchors the undead's will fractures. It takes a -1 status penalty to Will saves until the end of its next turn.

AnimationLaidBare.Title: Animation Laid Bare
AnimationLaidBare.Description: The piercing strike exposes a fleeting weakness in the undead's animation. The next attack against it before the beginning of its next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus.

UnnaturalBalanceBroken.Title: Unnatural Balance Broken
UnnaturalBalanceBroken.Description: The hit throws the undead's unnatural balance out of alignment. It takes a -1 status penalty to Athletics and Acrobatics until the end of its next turn.

GraveFalters.Title: The Grave Falters
GraveFalters.Description: The undead's awareness flickers with the force sustaining it. It takes a -1 status penalty to Perception until the end of its next turn.

ShatteredFrame.Title: Shattered Frame
ShatteredFrame.Description: The bludgeoning critical smashes the undead's physical structure out of alignment. The corporeal undead is clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

CrackedHusk.Title: Cracked Husk
CrackedHusk.Description: Bone, dead flesh, wrappings, or another physical shell splits under the blow. The corporeal undead takes a -1 status penalty to AC until the beginning of its next turn.

SplinteredSupport.Title: Splintered Support
SplinteredSupport.Description: The impact damages a leg, spine, or other support. The corporeal undead takes a 10-foot status penalty to all Speeds until the end of its next turn.

RuinedJoint.Title: Ruined Joint
RuinedJoint.Description: The slashing critical tears through a joint or comparable point of articulation. The corporeal undead can't Step until the end of its next turn.

FracturedGrip.Title: Fractured Grip
FracturedGrip.Description: The slashing critical ruins the undead's grip or striking limb. The corporeal undead takes a -1 status penalty to melee attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

PiecesMissing.Title: Pieces Missing
PiecesMissing.Description: The slashing blow sends pieces of the corpse, wrappings, or equipment flying. Until the end of its next turn, the corporeal undead takes a -1 circumstance penalty to checks made as part of manipulate actions.

CrushedRemains.Title: Crushed Remains
CrushedRemains.Description: The bludgeoning critical leaves the corporeal undead poorly able to exert force. It takes a -1 status penalty to Athletics until the end of its next turn, including Athletics-based physical maneuvers.

StructuralCollapse.Title: Structural Collapse
StructuralCollapse.Description: The bludgeoning critical buckles the undead's physical structure and sends it crashing down. The corporeal undead is prone.

PredatorBecomesPrey.Title: Predator Becomes Prey
PredatorBecomesPrey.Description: For a moment, the intelligent undead realizes it can still be destroyed. If it isn't immune to fear, it becomes frightened 1.

ProfaneArroganceBroken.Title: Profane Arrogance Broken
ProfaneArroganceBroken.Description: The intelligent undead's certainty fractures. It takes a -1 penalty to attacks against the creature that critically hit it until the end of its next turn.

MemoryOfMortality.Title: Memory of Mortality
MemoryOfMortality.Description: The impact awakens a fragmentary memory of being mortal, or of the death that made the creature what it is. The intelligent undead is stupefied 1 until the end of its next turn.

CommandPatternShattered.Title: Command Pattern Shattered
CommandPatternShattered.Description: The critical hit scrambles the simple pattern driving the mindless undead. It takes a -1 penalty to its next attack roll and its next Perception check before the end of its next turn.

InstinctiveBreakdown.Title: Instinctive Breakdown
InstinctiveBreakdown.Description: The primitive impulses animating the mindless dead fall out of sequence. Until the beginning of its next turn, it can't use reactions, and it takes a -1 status penalty to Reflex saves until the end of its next turn.

UnravelingApparition.Title: Unraveling Apparition
UnravelingApparition.Description: The critical hit makes the incorporeal undead's outline fray and distort. It is clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

SpiritualFracture.Title: Spiritual Fracture
SpiritualFracture.Description: A fracture runs through the apparition's spiritual structure. The incorporeal undead takes a -1 status penalty to Will saves until the end of its next turn.

ForcedManifestation.Title: Forced Manifestation
ForcedManifestation.Description: The blow forces the apparition into unusually sharp focus. The incorporeal undead takes a -1 status penalty to AC until the beginning of its next turn.

TornFromTheVeil.Title: Torn from the Veil
TornFromTheVeil.Description: The apparition loses its grip on the boundary between worlds. Until the beginning of its next turn, the incorporeal undead can't use reactions.

EssenceLaidBare.Title: Essence Laid Bare
EssenceLaidBare.Description: The critical hit tears open the apparition's spiritual substance. The incorporeal undead gains weakness 2 to spirit damage until the beginning of its next turn.
